functions.name: rg_elo_expected_score
functions.doc: Probability (0..1) that the player beats the opponent.

functions.name: rg_elo_progressive_delta
functions.doc: Progressive AP change by tier (actual: 1 win, 0.5 draw, 0 loss).

functions.name: rg_tournament_placement_prize_ap
functions.doc: AP awarded for a final placement in a tournament of the given size (0 outside the top 4).

functions.name: rg_bracket_single_elimination_rounds
functions.doc: Rounds of a single elimination tree.

functions.name: rg_bracket_bye_count
functions.doc: First-round byes for the number of participants.

functions.name: rg_clan_can_act_on_member
functions.doc: A clan member acts only on a strictly lower role (0 trial, 1 member, 2 sub captain, 3 captain).

functions.name: rg_sitemap_encode_path
functions.doc: Percent-encodes a VFS path segment by segment. Free the result with rg_string_free.

functions.name: rg_cfgbin_to_sql
functions.doc: Decodes a cfg.bin (RDBN or T2B) and returns its SQL script; dialect 0 = PostgreSQL, 1 = SQLite. NULL when the bytes are not a cfg.bin. Free the result with rg_string_free.
